cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the 2021 law reported in 2025 is not said to cover state data. The social support agency's systems hosted in the finance ministry's data centre (MAR-012) answer question 3 only, which places nothing without a rule in force.
cells.note: The draft 2027 finance bill plans a sovereign data centre for the state's strategic data (MAR-009, MAR-010), so stage 2. The direct social aid systems are hosted in the finance ministry's data centre (MAR-012), but every lower stage needs its own evidence and no rule on state data is in force, so not 3.
